fire_sales.driving_observable: DE-ESCALATED AMBER -> GREEN — the armed terminal observable FIRED. The Cursor closing 8-K was filed today, 2026-08-14 (acc. 0001628280-26-056945, verified directly on EDGAR; Item 2.01): the merger became effective 08-14, Cursor common and preferred converted into 389,289,254 Class A shares — priced per the Merger Agreement formula at the fixed $60.0B equity value over the 7-trading-day VWAP ending 08-13 — plus 1,752,426 shares for vested RSUs (~391.0M total, ~2.97% of pre-close outstanding, BELOW the 444.4M offer-price scenario and far below the 522-571M stress scenarios carried since 08-05), plus ~29,128,326 assumed RSUs and ~44,365,047 assumed options; issuance unregistered under Section 4(a)(2). All three consequences the 08-13 trigger anticipated are now fact: (i) the uncollared 1/P obligation is EXTINGUISHED — the VWAP window closed and the count is fixed; (ii) the $10B/$4B cash termination exposure is DEAD — the fees were payable only on termination and the merger closed instead; (iii) the consideration shares carry the Letter-of-Transmittal/Exhibit D lockup and do not enter float. The GREEN threshold ('obligations well-covered; ample headroom above any stock-price triggers') is now met by STRUCTURE, not merely by price: no uncollared stock-settled obligation remains anywhere in the public filings. Residual stock-linked exposures are all fixed-count: the EchoStar Spectrum equity consideration (NEWLY RECORDED from the Q2 10-Q — ~261.8M Class A at a fixed $42.40/share = ~$11.1B, issued only at the Spectrum Acquisition Closing, expected ~2027-11-30, outside date 2028-11-30; a future ~2% dilution event with NO price-reflexivity, though at today's $140 the fixed count is worth ~$36.7B against the $11.1B agreed value). Cash-side items recorded for completeness: the EchoStar deal also carries up to $8.5B of debt payoff with cash shortfall top-up plus Spectrum Credit Agreement payments ($1,241M in 2026, $828M in 2027); Valor lease debt is filing-quantified at $2,039M current + $11,290M non-current = $13.3B at 06-30 (vs $4.5B at 2025-12-31), Q2 interest $327M — real dollar-fixed debt on SPCX's own balance sheet, not stock-settled. Pledge channel remains ruled out (2,618,530 shares, immaterial at any price). STANDING OBSERVABILITY LIMITS: insider loan trigger levels unreadable; Compute Agreement Annex A unreadable but now MOOT for the termination fee, which died at closing.
